direction.instructions: Using only `state`, which position has the better expected result over the next 30 minutes after trading costs?

criteria.call_favorable: Index is more likely to rise far enough to pay option costs than to fall to the stop.
criteria.put_favorable: Index is more likely to fall far enough to pay option costs than to rise to the stop.
criteria.stand_aside: Expected move is too small, too uncertain, or signals conflict.

entry_quality.instructions: If the position proposed in `state.candidate` is opened now, how good is the entry location?

criteria.good_entry: Trend or breakout is intact and price is not stretched from value.
criteria.extended: Price is stretched from value; the move looks already done.
criteria.poor_location: Entry is directly into resistance (call) or support (put).

thesis_supported.instructions: If the position proposed in `state.candidate` is opened, do trend, momentum, participation and derivatives context all support it?
